decision_log.title: Multi-region rollout frozen until Q2
decision_log.decision: The multi-region rollout stays frozen until Q2.
decision_log.rationale: The board asked for multi-region in March. Jonah and Maya stopped it after the March 12 outage because the team cannot staff a second region. The team has not been told the freeze is permanent. Lena wants the successor to say that in the first staff meeting.

decision_log.title: No new services in the billing path
decision_log.decision: No new services enter the billing path until the Stripe webhook migration finishes.
decision_log.rationale: Priya is the only person who can sign off on that migration.

landmines.title: Weekend deploy freeze
landmines.risk: Deploys are frozen from Friday 16:00 to Monday 10:00 Pacific. A Friday ship in February paged Chris for six hours.
landmines.mitigation: Do not ship inside the freeze window.

landmines.title: Shared webhook secret name
landmines.risk: The billing sandbox and production share a webhook secret name in 1Password. Rotating the wrong item stops invoices.
landmines.mitigation: Ask Priya which item is live before rotating either secret.

sops.name: Thursday deploy
steps: Jonah posts the change list in #platform-deploys before 15:00 Pacific.
Maya, or the successor after Friday, approves the list.
Nothing merges to main after that cutoff without Jonah.

sops.name: Incident escalation
sops.when: When the data plane or billing is failing.
steps: Page Chris via PagerDuty service northline-data-plane.
If the incident is billing, also page Priya.
Escalate to Lena only if customers cannot pay or the data plane is down more than 30 minutes.
After 19:00, do not use Slack. Chris will not answer. Use the page.

day_one_checklist.text: Read the March 12 postmortem in the Platform Drive.
Sit with Jonah for the Thursday deploy review.
Get the 1Password vault Platform-Prod from Lena, not from IT.
Send Lena the Monday status note by 11:00.
In the first staff meeting, tell the team the multi-region freeze is permanent. Maya has not said that. Lena wants the successor to.
